claim: For any decision problem in NP\UF, at least one intermediate-result verification procedure is an exponential function of the problem dimension.
falsifier: For any problem in NP\UF, one can attempt to exhibit an intermediate-result verification procedure and measure whether its runtime is exponential in the input dimension.

conditions: under the paper's definition of UF as the subclass of NP with polynomial-time verification of intermediate results
under the standard definition of NP
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the formal framework and definitions used in the reported proof; transfer beyond that framework is unestablished.

title: Computational decision problems–existence of at least theorem
